name: Ahornseekiosk
kurzbeschreibung:
**Maple Syrup Kiosk in Söll**

Discover the sweet taste of the Alps at our **Ahornseekiosk** in **Söll**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Enjoy freshly brewed **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Apfelstrudel**, and warm **Kaffee** with a view of the stunning **Zillertal** mountains.

Try our **Ahornsirup** (maple syrup) treats—delicious pancakes, waffles, and more—all made with pure, local ingredients. A perfect stop for hikers, families, and anyone craving a taste of **Tirol’s** finest flavors.

Open daily, rain or shine—come by for a sweet break in paradise! 🍁☕

---
*(Location: Near the **Söller Ache** river, just off the main trail.)*
